# Untested in Godot.
# The Gradient interpolates linearly between its points (interpolation_mode is left at its default).
# fill_from and fill_to are the CSS gradient line of 210deg in a box with aspect ratio 1:1 (width:height).
var gradient := Gradient.new()
gradient.offsets = PackedFloat32Array([0.0, 0.16667, 0.33333, 0.5, 0.66667, 0.83333, 1.0])
gradient.colors = PackedColorArray([Color8(255, 0, 0), Color8(255, 136, 0), Color8(255, 238, 0), Color8(51, 204, 51), Color8(0, 136, 255), Color8(68, 0, 204), Color8(204, 0, 170)])

var texture := GradientTexture2D.new()
texture.gradient = gradient
texture.fill = GradientTexture2D.FILL_LINEAR
texture.fill_from = Vector2(0.84151, -0.09151)
texture.fill_to = Vector2(0.15849, 1.09151)
texture.width = 256
texture.height = 256
